metadata.transit_constraint: All 12 activities are reachable within ≤60 minutes door-to-door via Shanghai Metro or downtown bus from all 7 ranked central hotels (9 of 12 are within ≤20 minutes). Note: Suburban Zhujiajiao Water Town (~68–78 min on Line 17) is intentionally excluded from the ≤60-min core table and documented in Flagged Review.

activities.name: The Bund Waterfront Promenade & RMB 2 Huangpu Ferry
activities.chinese_name: 外滩滨江步道 & 东金线轮渡
activities.address: East Zhongshan Road No. 1 (Waibaidu Bridge to Jinling East Rd Ferry Wharf), Huangpu, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Walk 5 min from EDITION / 12–14 min from Crowne Plaza & Radisson Blu; or Metro Line 2 / 10 to East Nanjing Rd Exit 2 (~8 min total).
activities.operating_hours: Promenade: Open 24/7 | Public Bund Ferry (Jinling E Rd – Dongchang Rd): Daytime departures every ~15–20 min (10-min crossing)
activities.exceptions: Confirmed Official Winter Rule (Nov–Apr, covering Feb–Mar 2027): Bund & Lujiazui decorative architectural lights operate 17:00–21:00 (vs 19:00–22:00 May–Oct). Arrive before 20:30 so skyline lights do not switch off mid-stroll.
activities.cost_2_adults_cny: CNY 0 promenade (CNY 8 round-trip for 2 adults on RMB 2 public ferry)

activities.name: Shanghai Museum East (Permanent Chinese Treasures Wing)
activities.address: 1952 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Metro Line 2 direct from People's Square / East Nanjing Rd / Jing'an Temple to Shanghai Science & Technology Museum Station (~15–18 min).
activities.exceptions: Closed every Tuesday (except PRC public holidays). Walk-in entry with original passport (no advance reservation required for permanent galleries since Sept 15, 2024; Curio-City & Digital Gallery still require WeChat slot). CRITICAL 2026–2027 NOTE: Hosts all permanent Chinese bronze/jade/ceramics galleries while People's Square branch runs a single Americas special exhibition.

social_links.label: Shanghai Museum Tour — Ancient Chinese Art

activities.name: Shanghai Museum on People's Square (Special Exhibition Pavilion)
activities.chinese_name: 上海博物馆人民广场馆
activities.address: 201 Ren Min Da Dao (South Entrance on Wusheng Road), Huangpu, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Walk 4–10 min from Radisson Blu, Crowne Plaza & Treasury Hotel; 1 stop on Line 1/2/8 from Xintiandi or EDITION (~8 min).
activities.operating_hours: Day Session: 09:00 – 17:00 (Last entry 15:00) | Selected Day & Evening Sessions: 09:00 – 21:00 (Last entry 19:00)
activities.exceptions: Closed every Monday (except PRC national holidays). CONFIRMED 2026–2027 EXCEPTION: From July 9, 2026 – Nov 14, 2027, hosts ONLY 'On Top of the World Tree: Ancient Civilizations of the Americas' and NO permanent Chinese displays. Overseas visitors book via Trip.com / official WeChat; special-exhibition ticket price varies by exhibition (left blank below).
unverified_fields: 2027 special-exhibition ticket price for 'Ancient Civilizations of the Americas' (venue entry free for qualifying concessions, exhibition ticket required)
activities.verification_status: Hours & 2027 Exhibition Rule Verified; Special-Exhibit Ticket Price Unverified

activities.name: Yu Garden (Yuyuan Classical Garden & Lantern Show)
activities.chinese_name: 豫园 & 豫园商城灯会
activities.address: No. 168 Fuyou Road / South Gate No. 279 Yuyuan Old Street, Huangpu, Shanghai (Yuyuan Bazaar at No. 265 Middle Fangbang Rd)
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Metro Line 10 or Line 14 to Yuyuan Garden Station (1 stop from East Nanjing Rd or Xintiandi, ~10–12 min door-to-door).
activities.days_open: Daytime Garden: Tue – Sun | Winter Night Tour (Jan–Apr): Fri – Sun | Surrounding Yuyuan Bazaar: 24/7
activities.operating_hours: Daytime & Extended Light Hours: 09:00 – 16:30 standard / up to 21:50 on Night-Tour dates | Winter Night Tour ('Yu Xiang Shan Lin', Jan–Apr): Fri–Sun 18:00 – 21:20 (Last entry 20:30)
activities.exceptions: Winter Night Tour closed Mon–Thu evenings (except public holidays). MAJOR FEB 2027 EXCEPTION: Lantern Festival falls on Sat Feb 20, 2027 — Yuyuan Bazaar switches from free entry to timed peak holiday cordon tickets with extreme crowds 17:30–21:30; visit Tue–Thu morning at 09:00 opening for serene garden views.

social_links.label: Is Visiting Yu Garden Worth It? (4K)

activities.name: Top of Shanghai Observatory (Shanghai Tower 118F — 546m)
activities.chinese_name: 上海中心「上海之巅」118层观光厅
activities.address: No. 501 Middle Yincheng Road, Lujiazui, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Metro Line 2 or Line 14 to Lujiazui Station (1–2 stops from East Nanjing Rd, People's Square, or Xintiandi; ~12–16 min).
activities.exceptions: Visibility inside the 546m cloud deck drops to zero in late-Feb / March rain or low stratus clouds — check Lujiazui spire visibility from The Bund before buying tickets; passport required at B1 security.
activities.cost_2_adults_cny: CNY 360 standard 118F (CNY 180/adult) | CNY 536 w/ 125–126F Sky632 Damper Light Show (CNY 268/adult)

activities.name: Museum of Art Pudong (MAP — Jean Nouvel Bund-View Galleries)
activities.address: No. 2777 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui Station Exit 2 + scenic 8-min elevated walkway stroll (~16–20 min from People's Square / EDITION).
activities.exceptions: Prior booking requirement cancelled for daily visits (enter directly with ticket); tickets are non-refundable once sold. Note: 'Carolina Caycedo: A Tribute to Whales' closes Feb 21, 2027 — individual gallery floors rotate irregularly between exhibitions.
activities.cost_2_adults_cny: CNY 161 Night Session – CNY 201 Full-Day Fixed Date (Official Trip.com foreign-visitor portal: $24–$30 for 2 adults)
activities.verification_status: Verified (Official MAP site + MAP-linked Official Foreign Ticketing Partner)

social_links.label: Exploring MAP — Museum of Art Pudong 4K HDR

activities.name: Fotografiska Shanghai (Suzhou Creek Warehouse Night Art & Bar)
activities.chinese_name: Fotografiska 上海影像艺术中心
activities.address: No. 127 Guangfu Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Metro Line 8 or Line 12 to Qufu Road Station (1 stop from People's Square Radisson Blu, ~9 min door-to-door; 6 min walk from Bvlgari Shanghai).
activities.days_open: Monday – Sunday (Galleries & Café Bar Open Daily)
activities.exceptions: 1F Bistro MONA & Gelateria are CLOSED on Mondays (Galleries & Café Bar remain open until 23:00/22:00 every Monday, making it Shanghai's best Monday-night museum date!). Official English site links to WeChat mini-program for ticketing without listing RMB figure in HTML (price left blank below).
unverified_fields: Exact RMB exhibition ticket price (sold via official Fotografiska WeChat mini-program; not rendered on shanghai.fotografiska.com/en/visit HTML)
activities.verification_status: Hours & Restaurant Exceptions Verified on Official Site; Ticket Price Unverified

activities.name: Huangpu River 50-Min Skyline Night Cruise (Shiliupu Wharf)
activities.chinese_name: 浦江游览（十六铺码头精华游）
activities.address: B1, No. 1 Shiliupu Wharf, No. 491 East Zhongshan Road No. 2, Huangpu, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Metro Line 10 or Line 14 to Yuyuan Garden Station + 8-min walk to Shiliupu Wharf (~16 min from central hotels).
activities.operating_hours: Day & Evening Sailings ~11:00 – 21:30 (Peak illuminated sailings 18:00 – 20:30 in winter)
activities.exceptions: Cruises suspend temporarily during dense Huangpu River fog or typhoon/gale warnings. Book 18:30–19:30 sailing in Feb–Mar so Bund & Lujiazui lights (off at 21:00 in winter!) stay illuminated throughout the entire 50-min voyage.

activities.name: Shanghai Xintiandi Shikumen Lanes & Evening Cocktail Walk
activities.chinese_name: 上海新天地石库门街区
activities.address: Lane 181 Taicang Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: 0–2 min walk from The Langham & Andaz Xintiandi; 1–2 stops on Metro Line 1 or Line 10 from People's Square / East Nanjing Rd (~10 min).
activities.operating_hours: Open-air Shikumen lanes: 24/7 | Boutiques & cafés: ~10:00 – 22:00 | Cocktail bars: until 00:00 – 02:00
activities.exceptions: Adjacent Historic Site of the First CPC National Congress memorial museum closes Mondays; Xintiandi open-air lanes, Polux, T'ang Court, and cocktail terraces remain open daily.

activities.name: Tianzifang Shikumen Artisan Alleyways & French Concession Stroll
activities.address: Alley 210, Taikang Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Metro Line 9 to Dapuqiao Station Exit 1 (1 stop from Xintiandi via Line 13->9 or ~16 min from People's Square via Line 8->9).
activities.operating_hours: Alleyways: Open 24/7 | Independent studios, tea rooms & craft shops: ~10:00 – 21:30
activities.exceptions: Residential Shikumen upper floors remain inhabited — keep voices low after 21:00; narrow lanes bottleneck during rainy weekend afternoons.

activities.name: Jade Buddha Temple (1882 Burmese White-Jade Buddhas)
activities.address: No. 170 Anyuan Road, Putuo District, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Metro Line 13 direct from Xintiandi or Nanjing West Rd to Jiangning Road Station Exit 3 + 6-min walk (~16–18 min).
activities.exceptions: 1st & 15th days of the Lunar Month (incl. Lantern Festival Sat Feb 20, 2027 = 1st Lunar Month 15th day!) open earlier at ~07:00 with heavy local incense crowds. Courtyard entry is now Free; optional Jade Buddha Chamber upstairs may charge separate small fee.
activities.verification_status: Verified via Official Ctrip/Trip.com Attraction Listing (Standalone yufotemple.com English page offline)

social_links.label: Shanghai Old Town & Jade Buddha Temple 4K

activities.name: Shanghai Disney Resort (World's Only Zootopia Land & TRON)
activities.address: 310 Huangzhao Road, Chuansha New Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
activities.metro_route_from_hubs: Metro Line 8 (from People's Square, 8 stops) or Line 10 (from East Nanjing Rd / Xintiandi) -> transfer at Oriental Sports Center / Jiaotong Univ. to Line 11 terminus Disney Resort Station (~49–55 min door-to-door).
activities.operating_hours: Park typically 08:30 – 20:30 or 21:30 (Disneytown 10:00 – 22:00; exact daily hours released on rolling 30-day official calendar)
activities.exceptions: Multi-tier dynamic pricing across RMB 475 – RMB 799/adult; Feb 16–28 weekdays after Spring Festival fall in lower Regular/Weekday tiers vs weekend surges. Original physical passports mandatory at turnstiles (passport serves as park ticket!).
activities.cost_2_adults_cny: CNY 950 – CNY 1,598 (RMB 475 Regular – RMB 799 Peak per adult)
activities.verification_status: Verified (Official Shanghai Disney Resort Corporate Press Release)
